title: Campione d'Italia and its large antenna
description: Campione d'Italia is an Italian enclave inside Switzerland (Ticino), on Lake Lugano. It has coverage, easily recognised by the large antenna there.

title: Almond orchards (Apulia and Sicily)
description: Almond growing in Italy is almost exclusive to Apulia (if flat) and Sicily (if hilly).

title: Scale-pattern paving (southern Marche to inland Campania)
description: Small and medium old towns often have ornamental paving of small dark cobbles with a white scale (shell-like) pattern, usually with arched doorways framed by three stone blocks. It is found from southern Marche through Abruzzo and Molise to inland Campania.

title: Piedmont red brick houses
description: In the Po plain, houses of thin red brick indicate Piedmont, in the west. They are very common, so if you see more than ten houses and none is brick, favour the eastern side of the plain.

title: Mastic bushes (Sardinia)
description: Mastic shrubs are ubiquitous in Sardinia, especially near the coasts. They grow in dense, fairly low clumps with small leaves. They also occur on Greek coasts and islands and south of Izmir in Turkey.
